rules.statement: Stage row click on a draft stage that is rfq→auction, or auction with `route_auctions_to_auction_team`, for an auction-team user with Drafts tab on → create screen with `draftStageIds, projectCreation, projectId, title, isRfqToAuction, isEditingAllowed=false` — src/views/orders/components/projectCar

Stage title: rfi → "RFP", rfp → "Technical Offer", rfq → "RFQ", auction / rfq_then_auction → "<Strategy> Based Auction", lot stage → "<lotTitle> - <label>", vendor onboarding → "Vendor Onboarding" — src/views/orders/components/projectCard/projectCard.jsx:53-77

`rfx_mode` = `rfq_then_auction` when converting an RFQ, else the stage mode (`auction`/`rfq`/`rfp`/`rfi`); `auction_config` = strategy, sent `undefined` for rfq/rfi/rfp — src/redux/orders/helpers.js:1046-1051, 1097-1099, src/views/projectCreation/helpers.js:920-922

`title` = stage title; `template_uuid` = currentTemplateId; `vendor_assessment_template_uuid` = global RFP template; `stage_no` = tab position 1..n; `event_group_uuid` = project id; `creation_flow_type` = "quick_flow" — src/redux/orders/helpers.js:1070-1127, src/views/projectCreation/helpers.js:992
`default_event_type` → the first stage's mode in project creation (falls back to auction) — src/redux/orders/selectors.js:717, src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:2080-2086

`rfx_project_enabled` on → New Event opens a menu: "Single Stage" (`?singleStage=true`), "eRFX Project" (Add Line Items modal → POST `/event_groups` → `?projectCreation=true`), and "BOQ based RFX Project" only when `isBoqInErfxAllowed` (`?projectCreation=true&boqProject=true`) — src/views/orders/com

`rfx_project_enabled` off → `old_creation_flow_config = "show_old_flow"` goes to the old auction create route, anything else to the quick-create route — src/views/orders/components/projectTable.jsx:125-137, src/views/orders/constants.js:7-10

`?tab=` must be one of `live|history|draft|recurring` (lower-cased compare); anything else is replaced (history replace) by `?tab=live` — src/viewModels/orders/useOrdersListViewModel.js:82-110, src/views/orders/constants.js:231-236
"Created: <DATE_TIME>" only for auction-team users and only from the first draft stage's `createdAt` — src/views/orders/components/projectCard/projectCard.jsx:211-213, 300-310
Card link → `/project/<uuid>/details` when eRFX is allowed or the project has >1 stage, else `/orders/<firstStageUuid>` — src/views/orders/components/projectCard/projectCard.jsx:155-166

with `showMyOrdersByDefault` the My Events switch is hidden but the new ViewModel starts from `{live:{}, history:{}}` and never sets `myOrders`, so `only_my_requests` is not sent (the old selector forced it true) — src/views/orders/components/filters.jsx:251-263, src/viewModels/orders/useOrdersListV
RFQ→Auction line savings are keyed by `trade_product_uuid` and only strategies holding an object are sent — src/redux/orders/helpers.js:956-972

`is_allowed_to_modify_audience`, `is_rfp_template_edit_allowed_during_creation`, `is_publish_auction_in_draft`, `route_auctions_to_auction_team` (default false), `is_saving_configuration_mandatory` — src/redux/orders/selectors.js:720-727

History and Drafts badges are never shown: ProjectTable expects `pastProjectCount` / `draftProjectCount` but OrdersListPage never passes them — src/views/orders/components/projectTable.jsx:292-293, 757, 866; src/pages/orders/OrdersListPage.jsx:30-64

Filter options GET `/event_groups/filter_options` fetched once per session (skipped when already in redux) — src/viewModels/orders/useOrdersListViewModel.js:153-161, src/models/project/projectService.js:34
History/Drafts cards are grouped under a date header formatted `appFormatDate(date, DATE)` — src/views/orders/components/projectTable.jsx:846-858, 900-913
Empty states: filtered → "no result" copy; Drafts → "No Drafts Found"; Recurring → "No Recurring Events Found" — src/views/orders/components/projectTable.jsx:699-708, 914-920, 965-971
Saving filters/sort (Live tab only) calls updateUserPreference type `project` — src/views/orders/components/projectTable.jsx:481-488, 555-562, 640-653
Export `filters` = the custom filter value only (search text and stage filter are not sent) — src/views/orders/components/projectTable.jsx:329-331, 503-509
Empty Live tab without filters repeats the New Event button; with filters it shows the "no result" copy instead — src/views/orders/components/projectTable.jsx:699-720
Stage ref id hidden for vendor-onboarding stages and, for auction-team users, on draft stages — src/views/orders/components/projectCard/projectCard.jsx:442-447

`timeType = duration` → live countdown decremented every 1 s client-side from `timeValue` seconds; `timestamp`/`overdue`/`schedule` show the backend label/value — src/views/orders/components/projectCard/projectCard.jsx:116-132, 449-477

Draft stage: auction-team user sees "Tentative Date & Time: <DATE_TIME>" or "To Be Scheduled"; others see the label/value or "To Be Scheduled" — src/views/orders/components/projectCard/projectCard.jsx:478-511

Live: GET `/v1/trade/home?filters=<json>` polled every 30 s; History: GET `/v1/trade/history?last_updated_at=&filters=` (infinite, cursor = last item's `updated_at`) — src/viewModels/orders/useOrdersListViewModel.js:283-309, src/models/orders/ordersService.js:131-137, src/models/orders/ordersTransfo

Knockout/Dutch: `savings_comparison_on` = line-item when single product with offer on base price, lot when `savingsPrice.gross` exists, else "" ; other strategies use the drawer's radio value — src/redux/orders/helpers.js:903-915

DTE defaults: `is_default_dynamic_closing_time_allowed`, `time_extension_value` (→ custom extension), `last_n_minutes_for_time_extension`, `rank_limit_for_time_extension` (stored as string), `dynamic_closing_time_strategy` — applied to auction stages only — src/redux/orders/selectors.js:731-736, src
Auto-award is ON by default for every stage whenever `auto_award_configs` is a non-empty array — src/redux/orders/selectors.js:708-714, src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:2052-2071

No list request is sent until the user-preference GET (`getUserPreference({type: project})`) settles; saved `applied_filters` and `applied_order_by` seed the filters/sort — src/viewModels/orders/useOrdersListViewModel.js:129-149, 233, 281

History: GET `/event_groups/history?last_updated_at=&filters=`; Drafts: GET `/event_groups/draft`; Recurring: GET `/event_groups/scheduled`; each pages by `last_updated_at` — src/viewModels/orders/useOrdersListViewModel.js:198-278, src/models/project/projectService.js:23-32

Header shows creator name, `projectRefId`, "N item(s)" when `lineItemCount` > 0, red "Hold" tag when `isProjectOnHold`, "Auto created" Clara tag when `isAutoCreated` — src/views/orders/components/projectCard/projectCard.jsx:262-297
"Bids from Unregistered POCs <n>" when `pendingUnregisteredPocs` > 0; "N Message(s)" when `unresolvedChatCount` > 0 — src/views/orders/components/projectCard/projectCard.jsx:338-358
Stage `updates` render as tags (success/info/error/request/warning colours) with optional count and tagValue — src/views/orders/components/projectCard/projectCard.jsx:521-590
Stage owner shown as an avatar with initials and full name tooltip — src/views/orders/components/projectCard/projectCard.jsx:592-611
Recurring card shows "Frequency <scheduleDisplayText or ->", invited count, and status tag Active/Paused/Cancelled — src/views/orders/components/projectCard/projectCard.jsx:318-337, 421-439
Live response buckets render with "upcoming_orders" first, then my/team events headers — src/views/orders/components/ordersTable.jsx:157-170, 200-210

History-only filters: duration, template, order type, status, bid type, mode, strategy, QC (QC state only when QC "Done" picked), dispatch, payment — src/views/orders/components/filters.jsx:65-82, 153-250
Title filter placeholder adds "or reference id" when user `showReferenceId` — src/views/orders/components/filters.jsx:84-110

`bid_start_time`/`bid_end_time` are unix seconds; `extra_closing_time` = end (+cost-breakdown window) + evaluation seconds, omitted when evaluation is "Not applicable" (0) — src/redux/orders/helpers.js:1106-1108, src/views/projectCreation/components/projectScheduler/helpers.js:12-42

`staggered` = serialAuction AND more than one data row; serial rows get `start_time = start + serialDuration*i`, `end_time = start + serialDuration*(i+1)`, `line_item_no` = i+1 — src/redux/orders/helpers.js:1029-1044, 1075

`bulk_price` = `+basePrice`, `price_difference` = `Number(knockoutTick)`, `time_difference` = `Number(knockoutTimeDiff * 60)` (minutes → seconds), `end_price` = `+endPrice`; for non-knockout strategies `bulk_price` serialises as null (NaN) and `end_price` as 0 — src/redux/orders/helpers.js:1131, 115
